design.decision: Every round becomes a precision puzzle: bid conservatively, then duck, shed winners, and give away overtricks to land exactly on the contract.
design.opponent: Revealed on its first exact make; opponents can push an extra trick onto your team to spoil it.
design.rationale: A build-around for the Exact minor archetype; its signature matches seed-exact-x except for the amount, and it is kept because at legendary scale (about 27% fire) it changes how the run is played rather than adding a small bonus.
design.draftText: ×3 contract multiplier if your team makes its contract exactly

critic.concerns: Same signature and amount as cut common e-exact-xmult and differs from seed-exact-x only in amount; the exact-make puzzle is a good legendary moment.
